text:
sara: Heads-up — multiple customers reporting 5xx and timeouts on hosted inference endpoints starting ~23:12 UTC. P95 token latency jumped, gateway 502/504 spike.

mike: On it. I can see a sharp increase in 502s at the edge and 504s from inference-gateway. Pulling traces now.

jordan: Seeing a bunch of traces where the backend kv-cache access hangs: `kv_cache.get()` timeouts, then gateway retries -> upstream 502s. Also some auth refresh failures to billing-kms (429/504) around the same window.

kim: Graphs: p50 stable, p95 went from 1.0s -> 3.6s between 23:10-23:18 UTC. Token/sec throughput also dropped ~30% for hosted tier. Dashboard link: https://dash.internal/redwood/hosted/gateway/latency (sharing)

natalie: Any recent deploys or config flips?

mike: There was a lightweight routing tweak at 23:05 to prefer cache-backed nodes for small-seq requests to improve cost. Rollout was 10% traffic.

sam: I just rolled that 10% up to 50% at 23:07 for a quick perf test (bad call). Reverting now.

ops-bot: deploy-bot posted: revert complete for routing-change-2026-03-16-2305 (deploy id d-9987).

mike: Revert confirmed. Edge errors dropping slightly but still elevated. Looks like there's cache storm / stampede remnants — many requests miss due to expired keys and then flood backend, plus some stale connections to a specific inference pool.

jordan: I can reproduce locally by replaying a burst of many concurrent small batched requests hitting model-x-quant. Steps:
```
for i in `seq 1 1200`; do curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood-hosted/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer <key>" -d '{"model":"model-x-quant","input":"hello"}' &
done
```
Within seconds, kv-cache latency climbs and gateway returns 504s.

kim: Paging oncall infra to check connection pool exhaustion to inference pool nodes.

support_lead: Support: notifying top 4 affected customers and offering temporary dedicated capacity / burst credits. Sending standard incident template now.

sam: Quick mitigations applied:
- enabled stricter per-api-key rate limit (burst=40/s) for hosted API
- temporarily disabled prefix caching for model-x-quant to stop repeated misses
- purged kv cache for model-x-quant prefixes (manual purge)
Edge 502/504s dropped ~60% after those changes.

mike: Also enabled new fallback routing: if pool A health < 0.9, route to variant B (smaller model) for best-effort latency. Put that policy on a 1h cooldown.

jordan: Collected traces and saved sample flamegraphs. Noted two hotspots: (1) blocking KV access under lock during cold entries, (2) auth token refresh storms when KMS rejects with 429. Pasted snippet:
```
ERROR inference-gateway: kv_access.go:142 timeout after 2s for key model-x:prefix:1234
WARN auth: refresh failed: 429 TooManyRequests (billing-kms)
```

natalie: Action items proposed (assign owners):
- fix cache warmup & avoid global locks on cache miss (jordan)
- add circuit breaker around KMS refresh & exponential backoff (mike)
- add model-level request queuing / per-model concurrency limits (kim)
- update runbook: quick purge + fallback routing steps (sam)
- customer comms: full incident email + post-incident checklist (support_lead)

support_lead: I'll coordinate customer comms and offer temporary Dedicated seats where needed.

sam: Small follow-up: we've observed a billing auth IAM token refresh mismatch causing retries. Long-term fix: cache valid tokens per service instance and add jitter to refresh schedule.

mike: Can we prevent config rollouts that increase cache reliance without a canary & rate cap? Recommend blocking auto-scale of rollout percentage beyond 20% without SRE signoff.

jordan: I'll file a PR for lockless cache get-path and include local stress tests to prevent stampedes.

kim: I'll schedule infra capacity check and verify connection pool sizing to inference backends.

natalie: Please add ETA fields for each action item in the ops board.

support_lead: I'll draft the incident summary and proposed RCA. Expect a first draft in ~2 hours. We'll include timeline, root cause hypothesis (cache stampede + KMS throttling during routing rollback), mitigations, and follow-up owners.

mike: Post-incident follow-ups:
- implement per-model circuit breaker and queueing (2 weeks)
- token refresh resilience (1 week)
- safer rollout guardrails (1 week)
- runbook updates + tabletop drill (3 days)

sara: Thanks everyone. Good quick ops work. We'll track action items in the incident board and close the thread after the RCA doc is posted. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: Incident ticket INC-2026-347 opened and linked to runbook.

support_lead: Final note — customer-impact map attached to ticket. We'll include compensation notes for impacted customers in the comms.
